doc: Management of infants under 6 months of age with severe acute malnutrition

entries.claim: 小于6个月的严重急性营养不良婴儿应接受与6个月及以上婴儿相同的常规医疗护理。
entries.source_doc: Management of infants under 6 months of age with severe acute malnutrition

entries.claim: 小于6个月的严重急性营养不良婴儿的喂养应优先建立或重建有效的纯母乳喂养。
entries.source_doc: Management of infants under 6 months of age with severe acute malnutrition

entries.claim: 小于6个月的严重急性营养不良婴儿在以下情况可出院：有效母乳喂养或良好接受替代喂养、体重增长充分、身长别体重≥-2 Z评分（WHO儿童生长标准中位数）。
entries.source_doc: Management of infants under 6 months of age with severe acute malnutrition
